title: A simple choice based game that i made using gemini.
author: OcelotOk1744
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/dyfgcapnsvjg1.png?width=1916&format=png&auto=webp&s=eba2de450a5454087167c90dabd8b0baaf409b70

[Play here](https://college-sim.vercel.app/)

Does'nt have a very specific storyline as i was just exploring what i could do and creating different stories for different choice was rather tiresome.

replies.author: OcelotOk1744
replies.body: Don't know but I had a different window open for the coding part of the game and the story. Maybe around 40-50 for each.

comments.author: deviltalk
comments.body: Could you tell us how you did it?

replies.author: OcelotOk1744
replies.body: Simply told gemini to make me a project and described it as I well as I could. Told it not to write the story itself. After the first few steps I started with the story with each new choice leading to a different outcome. Mainly there are three branches in the story. It was very long process as I had to write the story and choices for the character myself, gemini helped me here by just formatting it better.

replies.author: OcelotOk1744
replies.body: Minimal. Only when sometimes gemini wasn't able to resolve something, I resolved it myself

comments.author: dropDtooning
comments.body: This is cool. One bug/QOL I would fix, is that it should move the text upward toward the beginning of the next scene so you don’t have to scroll up

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: Nice game! I like it. Would you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can also give their feedback?
